TURA BOOK ROOM TURA - 794002, WEST GARO HILLS, MEghalaYa. --- Page 3 --- MONDOLIRANG BAK CHIKUNGNI BAK SAKO ONANINIAMKO JAKKALARA KRAAJHA KRAJA man'gtmif tangka ba mimisi ba gipin bostu- rangoniko Isolna pakwatgimin bak chikungni bak sako dosomangso ba bak chikungni baksa minga. Mondolini korosna aro procharokrangko alduna badiaba mondolirang bak chikungn bak sako jakkalronga, indiba darangba uko jakkalja. A'chik songo ba gipin a songrango donggipa Kristi- anrang baditana kingking ako kakket ong'e jakkalenga anga u'ija, maina hisab ba gipin mesokanirang dongja. Indiba da'ororo adita banga Kristianrang uko jakkalenga, aro skangna bate bang'bata uko jakkalenga ine aganna man'a. Bak chikungni bak sako on'ani itihasko chanchiode, uni mangsonga, uni nanganirang aro uni chu'sokgijanirangko u'ina man'gen. Iako dakode an'ching iarangko nikna man'gen : ( 1 ) Ja dakbewalko ong'atchenggipa Jihudi jat ong'ja ( 2 ) Jihudirang uko jakkaloba bon'kamao uchin jagidotako man'aha. ( 3 ) Jisu ia dakbewalko manengjachimoba uko miteljachim. ( 4 ) Ong'chenggipa mondolirang uko jakkaljachim.

( 5 ) Ja'manogipa mondolirang brangangon uko niam gita tik kaaha. ( 6 ) Isolni kamna nambatgipa gilani chol dong'skaa. ( I ) la dakbewalko ong'atchenggipa Jihudi jat ong' ja. Bak chikungni bak sako on'ani nabachengani gimin an'- ching tale u'ija, indiba Abrahamna skang ruutbeon Babylon rang aro Misorrang uko jakkalaha, aro una agre Assyria- rang, Chinrang, Phenekiarang, Greekrang aro Romerangba uko jakkalaha ine u'la. A'bachengao dakgrikao amgimin- rangoniko gitcham jatrangni rajarangara bak chikungni bak --- Page 4 --- sako ra'draaha, ba rajarang uko kajina gita uamangni raiot- tangtangoniko gilrongaha. Rajd ,mitenl pail cing g'pa ong a ine ong'chenggipa manderang chanch:ani gifrin rajana bak chikungni bak sako on'aniara miteko olakiani bidir g onggipa ong'naba donga. Moseni salna skang Ibri manderang la dakhewalko gipin gitchan:batgipa jatskatangoniko ra'gutaha. Chubatgipa Isol- ni kamal Salemn1 raja Melkisedekna Abraham bak chikung- ni bak sako on'aha (A'ba. aro Bethclo Esauon1 katmiingo Jakob pilak man'giminoniko Isolna bak chikungni bak sako on gen ine ku'rachakaha. ( A ba.

(2) Jihudirang uko jakkaloba bon'hanao u hun jagidotako man - aha. Mosem ja mano bak chikungn bak sako on'ani tcromn1 -g iue  , '(: t soy ) enry.so s lueo oyretey chrion ong chong, boln biteoni ong chong " bak chikungni hak sako ra aha, aro uandakeba " t.atchu jinn.aon ba mcs do'bok jakoni monggotni ningo rc'gipani bak chikungni bak sa pilakan Jihovaona rongtalgipa " ong'aha (Lcv 27 :30 - 32 ). Deuteronon-y 14: 22-29 aro 12. 17-19 o sea gita 1a bak chikungn1 bak sako bilsiantio on e, uko Jerusalemona ra'ang- aha; aro uno, toromni biding alako dake Jihovani mikkango cha aha. Jerusaleni agrc chclode aro uko ra angna amjaode, indide uko tangkana pale Jerusalemona tangkako ra'angskana nangaha. Bilst gttamprako la bak chikungni bak sako songtango rakie, man'rikaniko man'pagijagipa Levi manderangna, songdongpaaigiparangna, pagrigiparangna aro segrigiparangna cha'na on'na nangachim. Manderangni nangani kri lani ja mano ia niamko adita dingtangataha. Skango Levi manderang bak man'pagipa- rangsan ong'aha, indiba Ja'mano pilak bak chikungni bak sako Levi manderangna on tokaha. la on giminoniko Levi manderang kamalrangna bak chikungni bak sako on'na nangskaachim (Chan. 18 : 21-26 ; Neh.

In- dakmiting somoirango, indakgipa obosta ongmitingon, aro indakgipa manderangna, ia bak chikungni bak sako on'ani dakbewalara namakonchim, maina uchin mangsonggimin dakna nanggniko chusokatna man'aha. Babylon a'songo rimgitangaoni, jakgitel ong'e, Palestine a'songona pilbaa intalan, chong'motan Persiani ning'o aro --- Page 5 --- Maxkabeanrang,ni sonui ong'muungo, Moseni niamko mande- r.ng agre duga dal'nikaha alo Suddukeerang aro Pharisee- rol gn dolra! g del io oangengachm. Ua somoio Jihudirang torui ni biillgo zipin udknd nianggnirdng baksa la bak chi ungni bak sako on'amko maindugaaha. Ka'saana bate n.a,ko nianianiko gamcilatnk balachim. Inciba lan biteara viu liual lije. ba gis.kru an doant komiroroangengani gimin ongdchifil. (-) Jisu u danbe'waiko inunengjuchmoba ua uko miteljachum. Jisu Kristo a'gllsako atch.on, Pnar seeiang bak chikungni b ak sako ul'ani giml.! tik ke ibeachim.

ind:ba mdnderangni ning'ugupa niungsorgako u igipa Jisuala udmang an tangtangko aru angeshako la kamchi liakdl Jdgidotatengd tale nikaha. Jisu uamangko manengahd. Ud iang an tangtangnt babils- guamoii uro jlian! b.k chikungni bak sako n'na simsak- ueroru,guoy., oyaunirdigpaeif uuplu fuput n "rgoprran gipdluug ' na'suang gang,uuku cheke gala inunba utko + ainuld' ine dgane Jisu uamangho manengund ( Moti 23 : 2-- * ). Gipin salo dn'tango ki'donge gipinrangko chonnik- Eiy a t'mar ltre saksani lsulu biunm baksa an'tdngko ouatgipa Sansd ka jana gigipeni Isolo bianiko tosusaahd.la Pharisce Isulko mitei thd rndind uu an'iangan gipimang gita ong'jachim, ua an tipruko chenggil okumu chakaha, ua pilak man'aon! bak chikungnt bak sako on rongaha. Indakgipa ong oba Jisu uko miteljahd, batesa ia Pharisceni cha chipilaniko pa- rakataha. (Luk 18 : 9-14.) Jisu pangnaba bak chikungni bak sako on aniko matnang- jachin indiba ua uko pangnaba miteljachim. Ua uni nama- ko chusukatani bilko u'ioba uni jagidotuni bilkoba u'idapa- chim. Bak chikungni bak sa Isolnin ong'ode, bak chikungni bak sku angnin ong a ine inanio jagidotani gnang.

Jeko dakna ska jena koros ka'na ska, ua bak chikungni bak sani on'spa, ba bak chikungni bak skuko, nokgipa dakna man'a ine chanchisretaniko bak chikungni bak sako on'aniara naatgipa ong'a ine Jisu u'ia. Ua dakani Moseni niamni biding ong'gipa ong'oba, uan Kristian toromni jakgitel ong'ani biding ong'gipa ongja. Uan niamni oikorni biding ong'a, janggi tangatgipa --- Page 6 --- Gisikni bidingo ong'ja. Uan Jihudi toromni sengmitchimitchia- nisan ong'a, indiba Kistan toron ni salni nabasrangani ong ia. Aro iako Jisu u'iaha. (4) Ong chenggipa mondalirang bak chikungni bak -ako on'ani niam dongjachim Jisu an'tangon bak chikungni bak sako on aniko namnike didiatg.pa ong'aha. de, irdide ong't henggipa K.istanrang lud niamko jarikpagenchim. Indiba ong'chenggipa mondolrdng indakgipd niamko donachim ine mesoknd saki r. Batesa una bate nambatgipa cholko ua skanggipa mondolirang jak- kalaha ine mesokna sak dongska. Jinudirangut bak chi- kungni bak sako on'anina Jerusaleno donggipa toron nokard bijatchigipa ong'a.

Indiba ong'chengao Kristan torumna in- dakgipa bijatchigipa grichim. (5) Ja'ma' egipa monde lzang brangangon huk chih uingn huh sako on'anikn niam gita tik hu'aha. Europeo, bilsi 800 A.D. na skang ruutgijann, Kristian mon- dolirang ia bak chikungni bak sako on'ani niamko gitcham Jihudirangni niamrangoniko ra'gate tik ka aha. la bak cht- kungni hak sako gilani a sclara, mondolirangni memborrang chu'ongako on'jaengani gimin. maikal skotonggipa pamong- rangko (bishoprang), ramram pamongrangko rakina, aro mon- dolini korosna aro kangaliangna nanga gita on'na man'gen indake ong achim. Trent songjinmao dal'gipa Melanirango ian, jerangan bak chikungnt bak sako on'ja uamangko a'pal galna nanga. Indiba ua salo inondolirango ongchongmot- gipa torom siangengachim, aro mondoli a gilsakko sason ka'an biding ong'gipa ong baskaengachim. Mondolrang Jisuni mangsonga aro uni skianioni bate bate ekangroroenga- chim England a'songo donggipa mondolirangni gilani mongsong- batgipa chol bak ch:kungni bak sako gilani niam ong'baenga- chim. Mondoliprakni elakao (parish) donggipa pilak a'arang- ni bak chikungni bak sako kajana gita mondolirang ra'aha; chong'motan, a'aoni pilak cha'gipa bosturang, gurerangni mat- churangni, mesrangni dugiminoni, aro na'tok rim ani labko man'giminoniko mondoli bak chikungni bak sako ra aha.

In- --- Page 7 --- diba ia mondolirangba Jisu Kristooni ekanggipa ong e iarang- ko dakengachim. Ua sal intaltal da ona kingking mondolirangni gisepo ba- diaba mondolirang nianiko tik ka ate, bak chikungni bak sako gilanichi pdmongrangko alduaha, procharokrangko rakiaha aro pilak gipin nanggnirangni korosko man'aha. In- diha jeoba, Je mondolan bak chikungni bak sako on'ani niamko tk ka'ataha, ua mondoli an'tangan uachi jagidota- taniko nan'aha. Maina Isolna ong'giminrang kusi ong e, jak- gitel ong'e, draguja on'an ong'ani pal mondoli bak chikungn1 bak sako on'ani niamko donaniara draatani gita ong'ariaha. Isolna on'aniko kajinako on ant biding gitasan ong'ataiaha. Kristian mondoli bak chikungni bak sako on ani niamko tik ka'ode, ua kam gital draka bitchiko gitcham bigiln basing- rango donani baksa apsan dakani ong'a. ( Moti 9: 17). lan Jagidotani ong'chongmota. Aro maikal A'chik mondolirang ia Jagidotaoniko an'tangtangko rakina man gen, uamangara bak. chikungni bak sako on'aniko niam gita dakjachina.

(6) Isoln kamna nambut'gipa gilani chol dongska. Bak chikungni bak sako on'ani niamko donatani pal Jisu ko ragatskabo ine anga A'chik mondolirango molmolbea. Angna la cholko janapna on'bo. Kristian mande Isolni gamni pamong ong'a. Gamni pamongn jako gnangan uni nokgipani ong'a. Uandake Kristian sakantini pilak gnangani uni Gitelni ong'a. Ua uni gnang- aniko an'tangn1 Gitelna agane on'na nanggipa bebegipa gamn1 pamong gita jakkalna nanga. Kristian sakanti an - tangan Isolni gamni pamong ong'a ine chanchina. An'ching- ni jako gnangdoniko Isolna bak chikungni bak sako on'na nanga ine chanchiani pal, an'chingni jako pilak gnangani angni Gitelnin ong'sranga ine chanchiatskagen. An'chinga ua gamni ong'chenggipa nokgipa ong'ja, uan Isolsa.

Ango je bilrang, je changanirang. je u'ianirang, je cholrang, je man'- giminrang aro an'tangni janggiba, iarang pilakan angna Isolni ka sae on'anirang ong'a. Ian chanchichipanisan ba toe agana- nisan ong'ja. Ian ong'chongmotani ong'a. Isolni bil aro ka'sara griode, an'ching saksaba changsaba rangsitna amja- wachim; aro jeko dakoba an'chinga saksaba an'tangtangni --- Page 8 --- Janggi tangani bilsiko mik saba batatna amja. An'chingna kam ka'na aro gamko r an'atna gita bilko on'gipa Isolan An chunga Iolni ga'n ni pa nongra g ong'a ine Jisu an'tanga skiaha, chongmotan, Monako Man'gipa Nokolrangni gimin aro Bebegipa Nokolni gimin toe agananirangcht mesokaha ( Moti 25: 14-30 ; Luk 12 : 41-48 ). Jisuniskia baksa Paulniba meligrikaha An'tango pilak gnang- ani Jisunin ong'srangaha ine Paul chanaha. Ua an'tangko Jisuni nokol ine pilnipil mingaha. Uororo nokol gam gnang- gipa ong ja, uni jako gnangani dongude, ua gnaugani uni nok- gipanisan ong'achim. "Anga Je ong a Isolni ka'saachi anga uan ong'a"(1 Kor.15:10),"Angna tangara Kristo" inc ingipa kattarangchi Paul an'tangdn Isolnin ong'sianga ine me- sokataha.

Gam ong'bo, bil ong'bo, changanl, sapani ba u'ian1 ong'bo, aroba janggi tangani ong bo, iarangni gimin Paul Jisu Kristoni gamni pamong gita ong'a. Ong che nggipa Kristianrangnt dakani ung Jr'uni aio Pauln skia baksa meligrikaha. Uamang bak chikungni bak san1 pamong- rang ong ja, indiba bak chikungni bak chikungni ba donggimin gimikn1 pamongrang ong'baskaaha. Ong chenggipa Kristian- rang an'chingna mesoke on'ani gita ong'a. Uaniangni gimin lako Wat.4: 32, 35o seaha : "Aro bebera'gipa Jjinma gisikan aro janggisanchim, aro saksaba gamtangko angnin ine injachim, indiba ua- mang pilakkon dondimachirn **** a'arang ba nokrang gnanggiparang pilakan uarangko pale palani damrang- ko ra'bae watatarangni jako donachim, aro nanga gita sakanntina suale on achim." Iako dakna nanga ine mondolini niam grichim, indiba ia Kristianrang ka'sagrikaha aro sakprakan an'tangko aro an- tangni pilak man'ginin Isolni ong'a ine chanani giminsan uandake dakaha. Jako gnangani pilakan Isolnin, an'chinga Isolni gamni pamongsa ine chanchiani maio pangchakchong'mota ? Uni pangchakchong- motani ian, An'chinga an'tangtangnin ong ja, indiba an'chingko rakbegipa damchi breaha, chongmotan Jisu Kristoni an'chi- chi breaha (1 Kor. 1 Pitor 1 : 18 o iako seaha : "Maina pagitchamrangoni ong'gimin na'simang ong'gramai- gipa' dakrongaoni so'gnirang rupa sonachi ongja, indiba ong'- --- Page 9 --- sigija, simteka grigipa mes br'sani gita, Kristoni gamchatgipa an'chichi na'simangko plokaha." Isolna Kristianrangni on - gnirangko on'an1 a selara Moseni Niamo pangchakja, indiba Jisu Kristoni chisolo pangchakchong'mota. Jisu an chingko piokna an'tangko on'chakani gimin an'ching una on'ani- rangko cn'skaa. Ua an'chingna ka'sachengahani gimin an'- ching una ka'saskaa.

Jekal Paul Koiinthirangna scaha, an - ching Kristianrangni Isolna on'ananirangko on ani pangchaka- niara lan : " Kristoilt ka'sara an chingko draata, maina an - chinga iako chanchie niaha, saksa pilakni ginmn siaha, uni gimin pilakan siaha , aro ua pilakni gimn siaha, tanggipa- rang maikal an'tangtangna tangjwaha, indiba uamangn gimin sigipa aro chakatpilgipand tanggen " ( 2 Kui. 5: 14 - 15) Iolna anga hadita on'ode kiag h, matkau I ol angu on all unko sing'ani pal ong thongmotgipd Kr'stian manie iako agane sing'skagen : Ango tangsipd pilanin isolnin ung a. la man'giminoniko cha na ringna. ganding chindingna mtam koros ka'na ranga Indiba ja kotesnu badita kraa, maikal anga. mikbokgipa ong'gja, Isoln! songnokko gipr.oroatna kraa gita aro chu'onga gita on'pana man'gen ? Jihudi mande bak chikungni bak sakosan chanchiaiachim, indiba Kristian mande Isolna uni gro nanggimin badita dal'a aro uan mai- rongpile chotna ampilgjdgipa gro ong'a uko chanchiskda. Ong chenggipu mondolirangni pamongrangko alduna, procharok- rangko iakuna, mondolini korosna taigka gilani rohom ma  Ua- mangni chol ian : " Jajrenga gita ba nanga gita ong'glja, sakanti ka'tong- tangtango mangsonga gita on'china, maina Isol ka'sroke on'gipana ka'sara " (2 Kor. " Antin1 skanggipa salo, na'simangoni sakanti man atangtang gita, an'tangni sepango chimonge, donchina " ( 1 Kor. Ia on'ani rokomko an'chinga chanchic nina hai.

(a) " Jajrenga gita ba nanga gita ong'gija, sakanti ka'tongtango "nanga gita ong'gija, sakanti ka'tongtangtango mangsonga gita on'china " ine talsrange semanaha. Kristian manderang --- Page 10 --- baditana kingking, ba badia bakko on'na nanga, mondoli niamko tik ka'atna bil grisrang ine u'ibo. Mande sakanti niam ong'na nanga. Mondoli on'anirangko maiha niamchi ra'draode, kusi ong'e, jakgitel ong e, dragija on'aniko cham- pengani a'selo dongenga. Mondolini niamni d aatanichi bang bca on'anirangko gilanina bate kusi ong'e, jakgitel ong e, dragya on'anirang, hang jaoba indakarang namen nambata aro Isolni nikao cholibata. Iako bang a manderang bebera'- jawakon. Indiba uamang uko bebera'bo, bebera'jabo, uan beben ong'a. Isolara ra dragimin kajanarangko uni dedrang- oniko man'na sikja. Isol uni dedrangoniko kusi ong'e, jajrenga gric, ka'sao on'giminrangko man'na skenga. Mondolini membor sakantin on ant badita ong'na nanga, uko mondolint chanchian pal ong'ia.

Indiba ian membor sakantin! skasanba ong'srangja. Membor sakanti, Isolni namukiko tikkele am'e, aro un baksa nangrimanio, lako nanten chan- man'gen. Mondoli lan1 gimin niamko dakna nangjasrang, maina gisikni dingtangatna anpilgijagipa, pilakko mikkang nigijagipa Isolni niam dongchong'mota. Ua niamni biloni mikboke on'gipaba ong'bo aro jaksrame on'gipaba ong'bojokna amjawa. Ua niam ian :" Bangguja dake satgipa banggja dake 'a'gen,aro patia gita satgipi pati t gita ra'gen "( 2 Kor. " Satpriprae batroroani gnang, aro on'na nangako on gija- on'gen, unon uni suaken; indiba jeo gri, uni gnangkoba uoniko ra anggen " ( Mati 25 : 29 ). Je mondoli bak chikungn1 bak sako on'na draatani niamko donata ua mondol sina- sienggipa ong'a ine an'tangko mesoka, aro ua mondoli uandake ra'draode bon'kamao ua mondoli sisranggipa ong'chongmot- gen. (b)Je /solna on'a,uko pangnan dakronga gita on'rongode nain- bata ine ong'chenggipa mondolini tik ka'gimin chol ong'achim. "Antini skanggipa salo, na'simangoni sakantian man'atang- tang gita an'tangni sepango chimonge donchina " Isolnl tangkako gilani maiba gisik ding'atanio, ba maiba rang'san dakatanio, ba maiba mongsonggipa molmolanio pangchakna nangaija, indiba cha'aniko cha'ani aro ringaniko ringani gita
